en: A vintage postcard view of a single‑storey colonial-era commercial building with a tin roof, wide veranda, and wooden railing. Several people stand on the veranda and near the entrance. Leafless trees frame the foreground, and the sky has a pastel dusk or dawn gradient. Printed multilingual text at the top identifies the location and the commercial house J. A. Serrinha.
